implementation: Operator-only pinned small/large-v3-turbo model aliases; small remains the default; ordinary users cannot submit a URL/model path
Bounded HTTP Range downloads resume interrupted responses within the process; exact ranges and final Git/LFS hashes are checked before immutable publication
Room audio/video playback reuses authorized chunk reads and whole-file integrity checks; no autoplay or model invocation
Closing preview/switching room releases the player source and Blob URL; stale view reads cannot publish a player

failed_initial_attempt.reason: Premature response EOF left wrong-sized weights; verification rejected publication. Partial was removed; range download then completed and verified.

parser_boundary_contract.scope: Includes truncated response recovery and refusal of a wrong resumed range; transport is controlled in this unit test

browser.scope: Chromium with controlled HTTP/WS and an actual two-second PCM WAV; verifies metadata load, explicit play and source release on close, not real service/model E2E

limits: Audio owner/action accuracy for the full recording is still unresolved; this is not a passed meeting-task E2E
No new Pi/Hermes model call or full CTest in this phase; prior real video pass and Pi visual failure remain separate
Browser playback loads and verifies the whole original up to 256 MiB before displaying a player; no streaming or browser codec guarantees
Model download resume covers transient failures within one process; process restart discards private partial files and reuses only fully verified files
Playback UI and new installer are worktree changes, not deployed or rebuilt into the application image
Real multi-browser media acceptance, shared asset deletion and final-message structured citations remain open
